Paul —

Great, thanks for the files. Quick answers below and next steps: 

1) Remittance & PO matching
- Primary key we match on: PO_NUMBER (preferably field labeled PO_NUMBER on your invoices).
- Acceptable fallback: PO_REF + DEPT_CODE (example: PO_REF=7843; DEPT_CODE=OPS).
- Invoice reference pattern we recommend: PO_NUMBER=7843 or PO-7843 (either is fine; we canonicalize both).

2) Micro-deposits
- I see the verification in our payments portal as "pending" and scheduled to send two small deposits (USD) tomorrow morning PST.
- Once you confirm the exact amounts, reply to this thread and we will finalize activation.

3) Deliverables from our side
- I'll route the final ACH remittance mapping template (CSV sample) and a short PO-tagging doc. Jon will add the required invoice label spec for FinOps.

Next step: I'll upload the remit_field_sample.csv and a brief mapping doc to this thread by EOD Monday. If you can confirm whether you want PO printed as "PO-7843" or "7843", we'll set the parser accordingly.

Best,

Paul — quick technical note from FinOps: 

We parse remittance using three core fields: INVOICE_NUMBER, PO_NUMBER, and REMIT_REFERENCE. For the automated reconciliation to attach invoices to POs we need one of the following present and machine-readable on the invoice PDF or accompanying CSV:

- PO_NUMBER column populated (preferred)
- OR: PO_REF + DEPT_CODE both present (fallback)

Example CSV snippet (remit_field_sample.csv):
INVOICE_NUMBER,PO_NUMBER,AMOUNT,REMIT_EMAIL
INV-11023,7843,12500.00,ap@orsetto.com

Two quick asks:
- If your ERP can export a CSV with PO_NUMBER as a top-level column, that will make the onboarding seamless.
- If not, we can accept PO in the invoice description but it will require a manual mapping step during the first 2 remits.

I'll attach the sample CSV and a short mapping cheat-sheet. Once the micro-deposits are verified we will turn on automated payouts.

Jonas Weber
FinOps Engineer
Redwood Inference
